description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Dack's Duplicate that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Dack's Duplicate token instead.
